reason: After reviewing the complete 20-F filing text, Cellectis does not disclose any Total Addressable Market (TAM) figures. The filing contains extensive financial statements, risk factors, business descriptions, and regulatory disclosures, but no market size estimates or TAM figures authored by the company itself. The filing focuses on the company's gene-editing technology platform, clinical programs, collaborations (particularly with AstraZeneca), financial performance, and operational matters, but does not quantify the addressable market opportunity for its therapeutic products or technology platforms.
